what: the same flanged hub profile revolved 240 degrees: its planar faces (three annular sectors and two end faces) must come out whole
method: a 240 degree turn is 2/3 of the full body: V = 2/3 * pi [(30^2 - 8^2) 6 + (18^2 - 8^2) 16]; area = 2/3 of the full-turn walls and annuli plus two end faces, each the profile (22 x 6 + 10 x 16 = 292 mm2). Eight faces: three annular sectors, three cylinder sectors, two end faces.
